optional_minigame_boundary.confidence: CONFIRMED architectural boundary; replacement behavior is an overhaul design decision
reusable_path: Choose persistent camp/training activity in Career Mode 2.0.
If the player plays the minigame, retain the original gameplay/result generation path.
If the player skips the minigame, generate the eight-stat outcome in Career Mode 2.0 using camp quality, coach, fatigue, development/potential and activity choice.
Feed that outcome into the same persistent boxer-rating writer semantics / downstream before-after result presentation.
Reuse Training Results UI fields aStats/aStatsDelta and the existing persistent boxer block.
optional_minigame_boundary.key_point: The minigame is not itself the persistence mechanism. Persistence happens at the boxer-data mutation/copyback boundary, so Career Mode 2.0 can make the minigame optional without inventing a separate ratings save path.
